items.stem: Which TWO statements about differential privacy are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: It bounds how much any single record can affect the output
options.rationale: Correct: that bound is the core DP guarantee.

options.text: A smaller epsilon means stronger privacy
options.rationale: Correct: lower epsilon means tighter privacy, usually at some utility cost.

options.text: It requires sharing raw data centrally
options.rationale: DP does not require centralising raw data.
Adding noise trades some utility for privacy.

items.explanation: Correct: that bound is the core DP guarantee.
